PSD.definition: Maximum accumulated dose on any modeled skin cell, reported in mGy.

RDSR.definition: DICOM object containing irradiation event geometry and dose metadata.

DAP.definition: Product of air kerma and beam area used by tabular exports and correction calculations.

HVL.definition: Beam-quality measure used by correction-factor lookup and interpolation.

k_tab.definition: Dimensionless correction factor for dose attenuation through the patient-support table or pad. A value of 1.0 means no attenuation; lower values mean greater attenuation. attenuation_fraction = 1 - k_tab.

below_floor_kvp.definition: Irradiation event with kVp below the lowest HVL lookup grid value.

kerma_meter_correction.definition: Calibration multiplier CF = (real measured dose) / (unit reported dose), applied per equipment × tube before physics corrections.

LON.preferred: historical longitudinal display alias / patient left-right axis
LON.definition: Historical PySkinDose display alias for the normalized X-axis, combining longitudinal table-position naming with the patient left-right direction.

VER.preferred: historical vertical display alias / patient anterior-posterior axis
VER.definition: Historical PySkinDose display alias for the normalized Y-axis, combining vertical table-position naming with the patient anterior-posterior direction.

LAT.preferred: historical lateral display alias / patient superior-inferior axis
LAT.definition: Historical PySkinDose display alias for the normalized Z-axis, combining lateral table-position naming with the patient superior-inferior direction.

attenuation_fraction.definition: Fraction of dose attenuated by the patient support, equal to 1 minus the patient-support transmission factor (attenuation_fraction = 1 - k_tab).

k_tab_status.definition: Per-event classification of how k_tab was resolved: estimated, exact, interpolated, clamped, no_device, invalid_inherited, or fallback (measured data unusable, so k_tab_val was used).

plane_identity_source_kind.definition: How acquisition-plane identity was obtained for an event: dicom_cid (DCM + recognized CID), dicom_code (CodeValue present but not DCM-CID-backed), tabular_raw_code, meaning_only, or none.

plane_identity_resolution.definition: How strongly plane identity is known: code-backed, inferred, ambiguous (reserved), or unknown.

psd_band.definition: Display band for a peak skin dose estimate: not calculated yet, low (below 5000 mGy), elevated (5000 to just under 10000 mGy), or high (10000 mGy or above).

tube_summary.definition: Per-tube (single plane, plane A, plane B, unknown) reported kerma, corrected kerma, applied correction factor, and partial dose-map peak. Per-tube peaks do not add up to the peak skin dose.

ask_for_missing.definition: GUI setting (default on) that opens a dialog when a detected unit and tube has no entered or file correction factor. It never blocks a calculation.

calibration_period.definition: Date range (valid_from to valid_to, either end may be open) during which a kerma-meter correction factor applies. Chosen per exam by the user; never read from exam data.
